introduction: Nine photographs from the NOAA/NWS damage survey. Compare buildings and infrastructure at different locations along the event. Each rating below is the assessment in the original photograph caption.
location_note: Locations follow the source captions. Exact camera coordinates and capture times have not been established, so these photographs are not pinned to the timeline.
interpretation_note: These are different sites after the same event, not before and after images. The photographs document damage; they do not supply a wind field or a building failure model.
